description: Erection of a single storey side and rear infill extension incorporating alterations to the roof on the existing single storey rear extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Location Plan, Existing Ground Floor Plan, Existing Roof Plan, Existing Elevations, Fire Safety Statement - received 14th February 2024, Proposed Ground Floor Plan, Proposed Roof Plan, Proposed Elevations, Block Plan - received 9th April 2024.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The window formed in the side elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
